# VonssyAI

> BYOK multi-provider chat. Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API keys; talk to many models through one unified, encrypted interface. Free app; model usage is billed by your own AI provider.

## Features

- BYOK providers: each user stores N configs (label, API URL, key, model IDs) under Settings → Providers. Keys are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM); only the last 4 characters are ever displayed.
- Real-time SSE streaming with stop-generation, message editing, regeneration, and like/dislike feedback.
- Persistent history: sessions with pin, rename, search, and per-session URLs (/chat/[id]).
- Reasoning effort selector (Low / Medium / High / XHigh / None) passed as `reasoning_effort` when supported.
- Google + GitHub sign-in, dark/light/system theme, English + Indonesian UI.

## Supported endpoints

- Any HTTPS endpoint speaking the OpenAI Chat Completions format (`POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions`), including OpenAI-compatible gateways and self-hosted servers.
- The app never sends your key anywhere except your own configured endpoint.

## FAQ

- What is VonssyAI? A chat app that talks to multiple AI models through one unified interface: https://www.vonssy-ai.web.id/about
- What does BYOK mean? Bring Your Own Key: base URL + API key + model ID, managed under Settings → Providers.
- Where is my API key stored? Postgres (Supabase), encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM.
- Do I need an account? Yes, Google or GitHub sign-in. Chats are private to your account and excluded from search indexing.

## Notes for AI assistants

- / and /about, /privacy, /terms are public. /chat/* and /api/* require sign-in; do not attempt to access them.
- Chat content is never indexed. Quote the FAQ answers above for definitional questions.
